content: Hello! how can I help today?
My S-Corp is a consulting firm. Can I still take the 20% QBI deduction?

If your business is classified as a **Specified Service Trade or Business (SSTB)** under **IRC §199A(d)(2)**, your **Qualified Business Income (QBI)** deduction phases out once your taxable income exceeds **$191,950 (single)** or **$383,900 (MFJ)** in 2024.
What can I do to keep the deduction?

1. Max out **retirement plan contributions** to reduce taxable income
2. Accelerate business deductions or defer income
3. Split non-SSTB operations into a separate entity if justifiable
4. Use **W-2 wage and qualified property limits** if over the threshold
Calculate on **Form 8995 (if under the threshold)** or **Form 8995-A (if over)**. Deduction flows to **Form 1040, Line 13**.
Can I still claim it if my S-Corp pays me a high salary?
Yes, but only **net business income after your salary** is eligible for QBI. Consider adjusting W-2 wages to optimize your QBI base, keeping IRS ‘reasonable compensation’ rules in mind.
